dimensions.note: intake and assertAccepted emit no entry or completion logs.
Intake returns stable diagnostics and assertion errors identify missing, invalid, or rejected persisted records.
Tests cover acceptance, idempotency, authority, expiry, bounds, paths, and persisted assertion identity.
Stable intake IDs produce deterministic results and assertion is read-only.
No external handles or temporary resources.
Published examples and fixtures are generic and synthetic.
Proposal, decision, result, authority, and public argument contracts are strict.
The result resource declares infinite lifetime and GC retention.
This is decision intake and assertion, not an external CRUD lifecycle model.
intake writes result at intake-<validated intakeId>; assertion reads that same stable identity.
assertAccepted uses context.readResource and validates the persisted result before trusting it.
Initial standalone publication; no prior published version exists.
